name: Graduate Diploma of Computing
notes: The formal Program Requirements say the 24 further units must be 6000- and 8000-level COMP courses, but the Electives advice says 'All electives should be 6000, 7000, or 8000-level COMP courses'. The formal rule is followed here: 7000-level COMP does not count.

The Program Requirements block gives no unit values per course; units are taken from the Study Options enrolment pattern (6 units each), and COMP8260's 6 units from the course list shown on the MMLCV page.
The Admission Pathways section calls COMP6710 'Introduction to Software Systems' and COMP6250 'Professional Practice 1'; the Program Requirements titles are used here.

Recommended electives (advice only): COMP6120, COMP6240, COMP6260, COMP6261, COMP6262, COMP6300, COMP6390, COMP6466, COMP6670. Students planning to continue into the Master of Computing (MCOMP) should complete COMP6120 and pick electives relevant to their intended MCOMP specialisation.
Course credit is not available in this program. Exemptions (e.g. COMP6710, MATH6005, COMP6250) carry no unit value, so an exempted course must be replaced by another course.
